name: guard-v17-mixed-vector-compatibility

pg_provenance_policy.source: runtime exact GuardQpIdentity.pg in every frozen target vector
pg_provenance_policy.claim: the run covers runtime PG4--PG7 and at least one canonical target vector spans multiple priority groups

selection_policy: V16 remains rejected because its exact three-PG grouping predicate constrained incidental registration order rather than the mixed-vector safety property. V17 freezes fresh seeds 152--154 and requires runtime PG4--PG7 coverage plus at least one vector spanning two or more PGs. The V15 ACK-clock mechanism, eight scenarios, safety gates, resources, and timeout constants remain unchanged. No performance artifact may be opened.
scope_limits: V17 changes the evidence predicate only; it does not change simulator behavior or reclassify V16.
Runtime masks come directly from exact frozen-vector identities and mixed-vector cardinality is checked per run.
This candidate-only campaign contains no HPCC or Homa arm and emits no performance result.
